theme: Open calendar, a few decisions waiting, girls home this week.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan — the day is yours. The weight sits in a couple of bookings that have been deferred and a recruiter note worth a reply.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV before it's gone
needsAttention.detail: Your top Todoist item, overdue since Sep 14: a full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out. Book refundable now and adjust dates later.

needsAttention.title: CIFIC recruiter awaiting your reply
needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani at Noorani + Partners followed up Oct 15 on a VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs search and offered to discuss it further. The thread is unanswered.

needsAttention.title: December break past its booking window
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by Sep 30 and book-by Oct 15 dates have both passed. Six people, 21 days over the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year, so a domestic pick booked soon is the safe move.
